title: Your next chapter, handled
text: Changing jobs should feel like a fresh start. But between benefits, deadlines, and unfinished reimbursements, it's easy to leave something behind. Meet JobSwitch: your personal agent for everything between two jobs.

title: One plan across the transition
text: Here, Alex is moving from Northstar Studio to Orbit Labs. These are fictional employers. JobSwitch organizes the transition into before leaving, between jobs, and after starting. The agent prepares the next steps, while decisions that need Alex stay in review.

title: Every claim starts with evidence
text: Take this learning reimbursement. The agent has prepared an eight hundred fifty dollar claim for review. We can inspect the supporting policy, open the exact page, and read the original wording. A policy allowance is not a guaranteed payout, and missing information stays unknown.

title: A separate, simulated follow-up case
text: Now let's follow a separate, two hundred forty dollar expense through a practice case. Alex has already left the company and lost access to the expense system. The employer's email explains an alternative route, but an itemized receipt is still missing. All correspondence in this case is simulated.

title: The agent identifies the missing piece
text: JobSwitch reads the incoming message and turns it into a task with a deadline and supporting evidence. Instead of assuming the claim is ready, it identifies the missing receipt and offers to draft the next message. Alex can inspect the source and review the proposed action.

title: New evidence moves the work forward
text: We deliver the next practice email. The itemized receipt is now available, so the agent updates the plan. The receipt supports the expense, but it does not mean a manager has approved reimbursement. JobSwitch keeps those facts separate as the application moves toward review.

title: Review the exact outgoing message
text: Before anything goes out, the person reviews the recipient, message, and attachment. This is the approval boundary: preparing work is automatic, authorizing an outgoing action is explicit. In this practice environment, the approved message stays inside JobSwitch, so no real employer is contacted.

title: Submitted is not approved
text: Next comes the acknowledgment. The claim has been received and is awaiting manager review. That is progress, but it is not approval. The inbox and task history keep the evidence together, making it easier to see what happened and what still needs a response.

title: Approved is not paid
text: Finally, the employer's simulated approval arrives. JobSwitch records the outcome without claiming that money has reached Alex's account. Approved and unpaid remain distinct. This is the value of following the work beyond a checklist: every status reflects the evidence available at that moment.

title: Move forward with fewer loose ends
text: From policy documents to a practical plan, from missing information to a reviewed action, JobSwitch helps carry the details through the transition. You stay in control of the decisions. Your agent keeps the next step in view. JobSwitch. Your next chapter, handled.
